name: Heriot REIT Limited
source: CORRECTED 2026-10-12 from Heriot REIT Limited reviewed condensed consolidated financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2025, released on SENS on 26 September 2025 and published at heriotreit.com/docs/results/heriot-condensed-financial-statements-2025.pdf. The file previously carried Yahoo derived revenue of 1,225,000 thousand rand for FY2025 against the issuer printed 1,706,944, and a negative Operating Expenses of 1,572,056 thousand that pushed EBIT above gross profit. Both are replaced with the issuer printed lines. Issuer printed, thousands of rand: revenue 1,706,944 for 2025 and 1,385,418 for 2024; operating costs 678,608 and cost of inventory sold 11,132, together Cost of Sales 689,740, giving net property income 1,017,204 as Gross Profit, with 2024 operating costs 499,267, cost of inventory sold 24,190 and inventory impairment 957, together 524,414, net property income 861,004; administration costs 95,500 and 82,286 as Operating Expenses; profit from operations 976,716 and 800,015 as Operating Profit EBIT; finance charges 489,961 and 432,118 less finance income 15,072 and 15,551 giving net finance costs 474,889 and 416,567; profit before taxation 1,622,515 and 889,729; taxation 5,442 and 20,636; net profit after taxation 1,617,073 and 869,093. The FY2025 figures are corroborated by the 31 December 2025 interim results, which print the prior year column as profit before taxation 1,622,515, finance charges 489,961, finance income 15,072 and net finance costs 474,889. Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit and Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit in both years, exactly. Net Profit is profit after taxation for the group and agrees with the issuer headline net profit after taxation of 1,617.07 million rand; the previously stored 2024 cell held the 664,734 thousand attributable to equity holders. EPS is the issuer printed basic earnings per share in rand, being 431.97 cents for 2025 and 259.92 for 2024. The ratio rows are recomputed from these rows and the group balance sheet in the same statement, total equity 7,979,403 and 6,780,577 and total assets 13,608,075 and 12,173,778; Debt to Equity is total liabilities over total equity, 5,628,672 over 7,979,403 and 5,393,201 over 6,780,577, which the issuer balance sheet already supported so it is unchanged. FY2023 and FY2022 remain as previously stored. | Yahoo Finance | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 1 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move.

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.derivedCellFormula: Gross Profit = Revenue - Cost of Sales

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedCellFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
